text: At 10am Judge Ana Reyes will begin an evidentiary hearing in the golf course case at 10am. I'll try to live-blog from the US Courthouse media room for @lawfaremedia.org . This is a case to stop Trump from converting a historic public golf course, open to all, to a Trump style championship course.

It's a fast-moving case. Last night Reyes denied a govt request to recuse herself. Trump said yesterday that he was closing the existing course Nov 15 (or earlier) to replace it. 2 days earlier govt attys called such plans were "conceptual," "nascent," & "preliminary."
